scope: Frozen014bb source and earlier observer-enabled original1000 harness. Source worker formula and pin ceiling, not measured instantaneous worker occupancy.
finding: Embedded worker dispatch calls server preparation and may block in reserve_until while owning worker execution. Current FIFO reader admission is already outside authority and retains fair/cancellable checks. Source worker count exceeds reader preparation ceiling; this alone is not proof of harmful oversubscription or current health starvation.
decision: Investigate whether blocked preparation can await capacity before consuming a worker while retaining request bytes/deadline/watchdog ownership and allowing query/control work. Do not cap hardware utilization to56, duplicate admission authority, drop pins early or repeat naive pin ceiling increase.
unmeasured: Actual active and blocked worker occupancy
Query/control tail latency during a write burst
